criteria.text: Running `pdd --version` from a checkout or branch build runs `git symbolic-ref --short HEAD`, replaces every `/` in that branch with `-` while leaving letters, digits, `.`, `_` and `-` unchanged, takes the first 9 hexadecimal characters from `git rev-parse HEAD`, and prints the package version followed by exactly `-dev.<encoded-branch>.<sha9>` (for example `0.1.9-dev.feature-2455-bd781e7d.5a45a2c8b`), one newline, and no package-name prefix.
Running `pdd --version` from the published release continues to print only the release version, such as `0.1.9`, followed by one newline.
